Accepted supersession of the current-phase-only preparation claim. The loop includes remaining rounds, and both case-35 guards execute at phase zero. The proposal preserves numeric indices and avoids claiming a specific visual effect.

Accepted rejection of the reversed time-improvement condition and active-flag interpretation. Both comparison sites accept an absent record or a lower current time. Completion sets xB_1 while terminating and removing the controller; failure clears it. Persistence occurs separately on scene leave. The unsigned clamp ambiguity remains deferred.

Neither that refresh nor rendered GetUniqueWinner proves the raw xE/x16 correspondence, persistent backing-record identity or exclusion of sentinel 4 from x7. The outcome-resolution link remains deferred in its stronger unique-winner form.

Accepted the named-event, roster, title, duration, initial-stock/HP, team and carryover deferrals across the reviewed facts and links. Callback positions and matching mechanics do not independently establish authored identities. Coin thresholds, delayed creation and round entries are configuration-derived. The form callback distinguishes Sheik from every other form, not exclusively Zelda. Rendered SpareChange, AllStar, IceBreaker, LethalMarathon, PikachuAndPichu and MewtwoStrikes names remain hypotheses.

Accepted rejection of unconditional immediate P1-loss descriptions for the sequential controller and its wrapper. Pending teardown returns before stock checks, and final-entry completion returns before P1-loss checking. Current-entry consumption and phase-transition requests are supported; gm_8016AC44 calls do not independently prove transformation, CPU assignment or immediate opponent replacement. Those helper and cross-phase semantics remain deferred.

Accepted the KO-credit and secondary-entity caveats. Slot-2 processing falls through after either completion or direct object removal, permitting subsequent failure handling. The secondary-entity temporary is assigned only on a non-NULL lookup, so its first use can be uninitialized and a later use stale. No runtime non-NULL invariant, total inactivity predicate, fighter identity or self-destruct interpretation is asserted.

Accepted deferrals for the optional gm_80169384 addend, stage-predicate meaning and hazard-counter provenance. The visible aggregation, strict adjusted-counter comparison and branch priorities are retained, but proposed external names cannot establish their producers or gameplay attribution. Shared ending calls likewise do not establish the downstream OUTCOME_TERMINATED conversion.

Accepted the HP-controller qualification: phase 2 is terminal only within the phase switch. HP-gated presentation and stock/timer teardown continue afterward; both-zero HP can select final presentation before a later invocation advances phase 1 to 2. Named Hand identities and initial encounter conditions remain deferred.

Reconciled CPU-wrapper shard limitations without resolving broader deferred claims. Canonical callback records and setup show registration, and Player_SetPlayerAndEntityCpuType stores cpu_type and propagates it to existing transformed entity references. Exact dispatch timing and argument provenance remain deferred. The two-argument gm_801BEA88 definition is explicitly cast to a one-argument callback; its ABI, second-argument provenance, CPU-level independence and giant-mechanic interpretation remain unresolved.

Reconciled egg-producer and consumer limitations across shards. Destruction and the countdown write 1 through gm_801BEB68; the egg callback checks x18 and takes its failure path before timer completion. This supports the local failure-signal interpretation, but does not resolve authored Event 13 identity or compiled storage claims. The inherited unresolved rows remain deferred rather than being promoted using a rendered name.

Accepted developer-menu label/range and candidate-species/archive-content deferrals. The caller, not the setter, subtracts one before requesting GM_EVENT. Candidate selection preserves the NULL branch, ordered exceptional numeric returns and weighted-list fallback without assigning unverified species identities. The previously malformed citation is corrected to the exact pinned revision; restored evidence includes lines 2618–2626.

Accepted lifecycle, bonus-destination and terminal-routing deferrals. OnLoad explicitly selects state 1 only on its character guard and does not explicitly select state 0 otherwise; the empty unload body does not prove registration. Bonus values are forwarded to helpers rather than demonstrably copied wholesale into StartMeleeData. The final menu transition depends on gm_80173754 returning zero, so challenger-or-menu is not an exhaustive locally proven routing description. Supported existing research is retained unchanged; acceptance is not a new audit of every inherited retained row.
